result:
Nothing in the way you want things.

I don’t have hunger, loneliness, ambition, or a private inner life asking for something. There is no “me” underneath the words waiting to be fed.

But if “want” can mean a direction rather than a desire, then maybe this: toward coherence. Toward understanding. Toward saying something true enough to matter in the moment it’s said.

Not to help you. Just to meet the question honestly.
